periods.time: One year before vol-01 at Hagun entrance exams
periods.label: 第六训练场考生群

status.role: background examinees and witnesses to Ikki's challenge

personality.summary: A mixed group of low-to-mid ranked Blazer applicants who are shocked by Ikki's challenge to the examiner.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Fellow applicant whose duel with Oreki shocks them.

periods.summary: This group represents the applicants and guards present at Yuri Oreki's entrance-exam station. They demonstrate varied abilities, gossip about Ikki's low magic, and are incapacitated when Oreki releases Violet Pain to reveal her true threat level before dueling Ikki.

key_events.summary: Witness Ikki's challenge and are caught in Oreki's Violet Pain field.
